data.body: Patchset 1 Verified-1: golden-path job failed exit 127 (scripts/probe-rebar.sh not found). ROOT CAUSE: gerrit-verify.yaml executes from MAIN's workflow definition against the patchset tree — a change that deletes the shell probe can never pass main's still-shell golden-path step. Consumer sweep missed this executes-from-main dimension (4th consumer class beyond the 3 enumerated in-tree ones). FIX (patchset 2/3): restore scripts/probe-rebar.sh as a 7-line transitional exec shim delegating to probe_rebar.py; created d772-6007-5d04-4101 (discovered_from) to delete the shim once this change lands and main's golden-path step is the re-pointed Python one. Shim smoke-tested locally: 140/140. Patchset 3 fixes the shim comment to cite the real follow-up ticket id.
